deviations_from_card: Acceptance case 1 says 'a nudge issues read B'; a bus nudge during a flight coalesces (case 3 requires it), so the superseding read is refresh(), which every act calls after its request - the test drives load() then refresh(). Options named maxReads (not maxRepeats); follow is passed as a getter so the store's swappable deps stay live. One commit instead of three (all green together). Sleep's acts now supersede the read out instead of awaiting it and reading again (ADR 0217 consequences); its 2 guard tests and all other sleep tests pass unchanged. Case 4 was red before via TypeError (old follow had no onConnected), not a count mismatch. Case 6 red-before is module-missing (mirror.ts absent).
